profiles.name: catalog
profiles.definition: Native catalog capability/0.1: explicit original UMF preparation; current compatible acceptance and unchanged/historical retry; exact original reports; complete native catalog view; person-scoped module/source reads; caller-owned transaction; no administrative installation or module grants.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native catalog policy/0.1: ordinary authenticated person; registrar membership for acceptance, original reports and complete catalog view; current module reader or writer for person-scoped catalog and accepted document reads; exact installed release; READ COMMITTED; no installation administration authority.

profiles.name: direct_read
profiles.definition: Native direct read capability/0.1: rootless exact scalar object identity/key/live pages; independent directed edge identity/relationship pages; authority receipt visibility; current document-qualified module authority; read-only READ COMMITTED supported; no structured ownership, general historical records or compiler execution.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native direct-read policy/0.1: ordinary authenticated person; current document-qualified reader or writer for object, property, relationship and endpoint dependencies used by each supported read; no writer-only gate; READ COMMITTED and supported read-only transactions; exact installed release; no raw table privileges.

profiles.name: import
profiles.definition: Native host-adopted import capability/0.1: immutable explicit original source documents; context and primary identity construction; per-record scalar object/independent edge import dispositions; original provenance and reservations; pending caller settlement; no engine-owned batches or verified commit.

profiles.name: feed
profiles.definition: Native caller-asserted feed capability/0.1: complete authority-database transactions below snapshot xmin; original catalog/report/configuration prerequisites; journal/source/reservation union; full historical module authority; ordinary-role full-prior source interval CAS ACK; caller asserts downstream durability; no verified application or retention release; no administration.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native caller-asserted feed policy/0.1: ordinary authenticated person enrolled under the consumer role and fresh registration; current reader or writer authority for every module in historical source documents; complete source scope with no filtered sibling; authority database and READ COMMITTED; source-only expected-prior ACK; no downstream verifier or retention release.
